Game Overview

In Tiny Red Bird, the core idea is straightforward: guide a Tiny Red Bird through a perilous sky, mastering the rhythm of taps to navigate deadly obstacles. This addictive arcade experience blends simple controls with escalating challenges, inviting you to break records and compete with friends in a world of enchanting visuals and captivating soundscapes.
